patterns: Recurring character beats the one-liner: lexx_aura 'This AI video is absolutely amazing 🔥 / Malfoy is totally crazy / Seedance 2.5' hit 337.5K from a Tue 13:44 post. Same three-line caption as the masterpiece clones, but with a named recurring character in line two. A series hero gives people a reason to come back

The masterpiece one-liner is saturating: in the last 24h wiliam_web3 did 9.4K and Xmbluee 5.7K, but a dozen other clones (Arisha_Hoqe, SimplyAnnisa, Enaya_ai, DexXonAI, AiWithSania) stayed between 600 and 3.9K. Keep the short tool-named caption, but add a specific story line instead of only 'masterpiece'

Menace in one sentence works for dark fantasy: Diesel_lord 'The most terrifying tyrants are the ones who never speak.' plus 'A dark fantasy short film about...' reached 15.0K (Mon 19:08). A quiet, ominous one-line hook, then a one-line logline

Seasonal is starting: lexx_aura's Black Friday product transformation reached 19.8K (Tue 19:49) and SadiaMalik182's sponsored agent quotes held 11.8K and 7.4K. Not Patrick's niche, but a 'gift' or 'treasure' angle can ride the Black Friday week

Patrick posted 6 originals since Monday, best 'The Purple Rune Warrior Queen' at 44 (Mon 12:35). Today he already posted 3 times 09:04-09:49 (18, 7, 5 views). The hits land 13:00-20:00 Amsterdam; one post in that window beats three in an hour
